Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production raster sprite source for HARVEST THE NIGHT, a cozy farm that becomes a fortress against zombies at night.
Primary request: A040 identity master, ONE fresh garlic braid hanging from a short wooden stake with small crosspiece.
Input images: Image1 reference-sheet is style/materials; Image2 barricade is canvas/density/ground scale; Image3 ripegarlic is bulb colours/material only; Image4 farmer scale only.
Style/medium: coherent hand-crafted pixel art with deliberate pixel clusters, colored outlines, restrained texture, readable material planes and clean forms.
Composition/framing: orthographic three-quarter top-down view on rectangular grid; match farm camera. Native16x24, pivot(8,20), lowest opaque row19. Visible11wide x18tall. One short thin timber stake with crosspiece, not a large structure.
Lighting/mood: neutral warm daytime, upper-left highlights, dark undersides; runtime provides night.
Color palette: warm wood, gold dried plaited stems, bone/bone_dark pale garlic bulbs with faint violet streaks; NOTblue glowing bulbs.
Family WALL_TRAP adapted: small walkable garlic braid on a stake, six plump bulbs in a hanging plait. Each bulb is a broad2–3nativepixel pale cluster, few large bulbs rather than many tiny. Stake centred, no fence/wall, no pot or ground patch, no aura.
Scene/backdrop: TRUE transparent outside sharp solid object pixels, alpha0, NO glow/haze or ground shadow.
Constraints: complete unclipped single object, stable ground contact, no labels/text/watermark/UI/other objects. No blur/gradient/anti-aliasing/vector/3D/randomspeckle/blackboxes/diamondbase; simple enough to remain readable at11x18.

Preserve all style/colour/camera. No glow/gradient/haze outside object; absolute transparent background.
